scope: Production Website TS/TSX; tests, executable examples and primitive demonstration modules are excluded.

nativeControls.reason: Icon-role token fixture: directly compares primary/secondary/disabled icon colors without UI Button state styling.
Text/placeholder token fixture: exposes raw input text and placeholder colors in the semantic recipe.
Input-row brand token fixture: displays the save-action color recipe; no save command is implemented.
Elevated-surface token fixture: displays the action color on an elevated sample; no popup action is implemented.
Brand normal-state measurement fixture: directly exposes solid and foreground tokens.
Brand hover-state measurement fixture: displays the hover token independently of pointer state.
Brand active-state measurement fixture: displays the active token independently of pointer state.
Brand selected-state measurement fixture: displays the subtle/selected token recipe.
Typography label-recipe fixture: its child TypeSample exposes the exact UI label recipe; no save command is implemented.
Read-only typography input fixture: exposes the UI body recipe on an actual input, without Input typography defaults.
Read-only typography input fixture: exposes the UI body recipe on a slug field, without Input typography defaults.
